$comment: Asset slots. Drop a file named <id>.<ext> into public/assets/ and it is used automatically (run `npm run assets:scan`, or just start studio/render). Without a file, the film renders its built-in procedural visual for that moment.

slots.description: Official Premium Seeds logo. Transparent SVG or PNG, light version for dark background (or dark logo; see README: logo is tinted cream by default).
Real photo/clip of a Premium Seeds breeder examining plants, or the company's research facility. Landscape, subject on the right half, darkish background preferred.
slots.fallback: Botanical research plate (line-art seedling, leaf-cell micrograph, F1 cross diagram).

slots.description: Real wide shot of the company's trial field: crop rows, low sun, ideally a person walking the rows. Landscape.
slots.fallback: Procedural perspective field at golden hour (no people).

slots.description: Close-up of a Premium Seeds chilli (fruit on dark/neutral background works best).
Top Gun F1 product image from the website (ideally a cut-out PNG of the chilli on transparency, or a dark-background photo).
slots.fallback: Procedural macro chilli (green ripening to red).

slots.description: Real photo/clip of a farmer inspecting a crop grown from Premium Seeds (with consent).
slots.fallback: Procedural backlit chilli canopy at golden hour.

slots.description: Close-up of hands touching plants / harvesting.
slots.fallback: Procedural backlit chilli canopy at golden hour.

slots.description: Basket / crate of harvested vegetables in sunlight.
slots.fallback: Procedural backlit chilli canopy at golden hour.

slots.description: Licensed music track. Replaces the generated score (the generated sound-design layer stays; see README to mute it).
